# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large, noisy mix of transcripts. The majority are **not real sales conversations** — they are logistics/transporter coordination calls (vehicle booking, loading/unloading, weighment disputes, driver follow-up with Trans Raipur/Nagpur/Tirupati parties), internal CTL/operator production/cutting calls (Yuvraj Operator series), MTC/TC/tag documentation chases (Uniqcore Const Site Vinoth), payment-collection follow-ups (Swathika BSC series), wrong numbers, voicemails, and garbled/unintelligible Telugu-Hindi-Tamil fragments (Tirupati Balasubramaniam series has heavy static/low-signal content).

The **genuine sales-relevant calls** are a smaller subset: rate enquiries, quotation negotiations, order confirmation, dealer-to-dealer broker calls (Tirupati Balasubramaniam, Vizag Dushyant transport-cum-rate calls), and site/fabricator purchase calls (Thangaraj Metfra, Vadivel T S/Sangeetha Traders, V R Earth Movers, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Uniqcore Const Balakrishnan, TAMILARASAN KUMAR, German Polymers/T Ravikumar, VD Engineering/Vasudevan K). This KB is distilled **only** from those genuine sales exchanges. Given the heavy dilution with ops/logistics content, conclusions here are grounded strictly in the lines quoted — no invented pricing or policy.

## Products & brand ladder

BSC trades **steel long and flat products**, sourced both as **main/primary mill material** and **re-rolled/secondary** material. Roofing is NOT a product line seen in these calls — ignore any such assumption.

Product lines actually discussed:
- **MS Plates** (checkered plate, HR/normal plate) — thickness range 3mm–45mm+, widths 1250/1500/2000/2500mm, standard lengths 6.3m/12m; size/length cutting service offered ("நாங்களே cut பண்ணி கொடுத்துருவோம்").
- **Channel (ISMC)** — e.g., 200x75, custom lengths like 24.5m made by joining/cutting to size.
- **Beam (ISMB)** — e.g., 400x140, 250 high beam.
- **Angle** — MS L angle (bolt/hanger angles explicitly NOT stocked: "angle bolt-லாம் sale-ல பண்ண மாட்டாங்க").
- **TMT bars** — grades FE500, FE550D/550D, E250 BR, E350 BR; brands RINL/Vizag ("Sale Vizag"), SAIL, Tata. E350/E500 BR explicitly called **rare/non-stock** items ("E350 BR ரொம்ப rare தான் sir கிடைக்கிறது").
- **HR Coils** — sold as coil-to-coil (full coil, cheaper ~₹500/ton less) or cut-to-width/length (standard rate, customer loses end-bit/scrap).
- **Flat bars** — e.g., 50x5, 100x6.
- **Pipes** — CHS pipe, square/rectangular pipe, RHS (explicitly told "நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல" for CHS/pipe sourcing — BSC sources externally if needed, doesn't stock).
- **Checkered plate / sheet** — including thin CR sheet (0.6mm IS 513) sourced via known vendor, not direct stock.
- **MPP (structural)** — 500 size, 12m length, SAIL brand mentioned.

**Brand ladder / make hierarchy** (as explained to customers):
1. **Main/Sale material** (e.g., "Sale Vizag", RINL) = primary mill production — positioned as full price, no compromise.
2. **Rolling/Secondary** (e.g., "Salem Steel Plant" rolled channel) = cheaper, explicitly flagged when a customer's competitor quote looks suspiciously low: "அது rolling... Salem Steel Plant-ஓட குடுத்துருக்காங்க."
3. Distinction is used proactively in sales talk to justify price gaps and defend against competitor rate comparisons.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

All rates are **per ton**, quoted as **ex-work + GST extra** (confirmed repeatedly: "Rate-ல இருந்து + GST", "GST extra"), with **loading/transport charges extra** unless stated.

- Checkered plate (German Polymers deal): ₹65,000/ton + GST (sale, main material).
- Structural steel (Thirusha Enterprise — 250 high beam, Apollo-type primary): ₹62,500 + GST, loading & transport extra; rate band cited "60 to 500 per ton" fluctuating.
- V R Earth Movers plate/ISMB rate history: ₹60–63/kg basis quoted across multiple calls — ₹61 → ₹63 → ₹65.50 over weeks, with explicit "₹1,500 increase" and "₹2,000 increase" updates each time. E350 grade = **+₹3,000 extra** over E250.
- Uniqcore Const (Balakrishnan) — item-wise rates finalized: ₹71,750 / ₹73,750 / ₹75,750 (confirmed as "same rate", only ~₹100–200 flexibility ever given).
- Vinayaga Steel Pradeep — plate rates ₹61–64/kg band; 2mm sheet slightly higher (~₹63); request for ₹500 reduction on 8mm/5mm plate (4x8) met with "63.5 கொடுங்க" counter (partial give).
- TMT via Tirupati Balasubramaniam broker chain: rates bounce ₹65–₹71 depending on size (8mm, 10mm, 12–25mm, 16mm) and location (Tirupati vs Chennai vs AP) — demonstrates **regional price variation strategy**: "Chennai-ல material demand இருக்கு, அதனால அந்த rate போகும். இங்க AP-ல demand இல்ல."
- TAMILARASAN KUMAR — plate ~₹67,500 (20mm) vs ₹75,000 (40mm), ₹7,500 difference citing thickness-based rate increments; coil vs cut rate differs by ₹500 ("coil to coil-னா கம்மியாகும்", end-bit/scrap trade-off explained).
- Vidveda Krishnasamy — ISMB/TMT enquiries; credit terms explicitly limited: **"1 month தான்"** credit period mentioned, advance payment preferred over credit.
- V R Earth Movers — payment terms: **"full payment இருந்தாதான் sir block பண்ண முடியும்"** (no material block without full payment); rate validity window stated as "today only," next-day = new (higher) rate.
- Wayment/handling charges: standard **₹200 "payment charges"** per vehicle acknowledged as policy ("வண்டி capacity வச்சு அவங்க போடுவாங்க", standardized, not negotiable per call but one-off mistakes get a debit/credit note correction).
- Uniqcore Vinoth (Amazon-style structural/TMT site): rate delta flagged when customer finds competitor (Kapil) at ₹1 less per kg on bulk quantity — handled by escalation ("சார் கிட்ட கேட்டு வேணா சொல்றேன்").

## Objection Playbook

**1. "Rate too high / competitor is cheaper"**
- Response pattern: differentiate on **make/brand quality** — "அது rolling... நம்மளது rate-ஏ கரெக்ட்." Position competitor's lower price as secondary/rolled material, not main/sale material.
- Acknowledge honestly when gap is small ("₹100, ₹200 இருந்தா... ஆரம்பிக்க") but refuse to match large gaps ("2000, 3000 different-னா கண்டிப்பா பண்ண முடியாது").
- Offer a **token reduction** (₹100–500/ton) rather than full match — seen repeatedly: "₹100-200 கம்மி பண்ணுங்க, அவ்வளோதான்."

**2. "Rate increased again / why so often"**
- Acknowledge market reality directly: "Market அந்த மாதிரி தான் sir இருக்கு, rate increase ஆக போகுது" — never apologize for increases, frame as external/mill-driven, not company decision.
- When accused of "loading charge" being newly added unfairly: hold firm but escalate to MD if customer pushes ("MD கிட்டயே request பண்ணி கேட்டு").

**3. "Give discount / final rate possible?"**
- Standard refusal with firmness: "Rate-ல இருந்து எதுவும் discount பண்ண முடியாது sir. ஏன்னா rate எல்லாமே increase ஆயிடுச்சு."
- Small symbolic flexibility only on request escalation (₹50/₹500 per ton), tied to **quantity commitment** ("நீங்க எவ்வளவு எடுக்க போறீங்கன்னு சொல்லுங்க").

**4. "Material not ready / stock unavailable"**
- Honest stock-status answers: distinguish **"stock இருக்கு"** vs **"cut ஆகலையா"** vs **"coil எடுக்கலையா"** — operators are trained to clarify precisely rather than give vague "no stock."
- Rare grades (E350 BR, FE500 pure) explicitly flagged as hard-to-source, set expectation ("rare தான்", "stock வைக்கிறது இல்ல, against order தான் வாங்கித் தரோம்").

**5. "Need credit / payment after delivery"**
- Firm no-credit-without-approval stance: "Full-ஆ பண்ணாதான் வண்டி release பண்ணுவோம்." Limited credit (1 month) given only to known/trusted accounts
